title: Build C40, then choose its end-group framework.
C40 사슬을 만든 뒤 말단 고리로 분기.
intro: Two GGPP molecules supply the C40 chain. After desaturation and isomerisation, ring-forming enzymes act on its ends. Read open-chain, one-ring and two-ring classes before opening the full carotenoid pathway.
GGPP 두 분자가 C40 사슬을 공급합니다. 탈수소화·이성질화 뒤 고리화 효소가 사슬 말단에 작용합니다. 열린 사슬·한 고리·두 고리 계열을 먼저 비교하고 상세 카로티노이드 경로로 펼쳐보세요.

edges.label: 2 GGPP · PSY / CrtB · C40
edges.detail: Two C20 GGPP molecules condense to the C40 15-cis product through prephytoene diphosphate within the reaction.

edges.label: Desaturation + isomerisation
edges.detail: A condensed sequence. Lycopene-forming CrtI and plant PDS/Z-ISO/ZDS/CRTISO systems have different intermediate geometries and enzyme arrangements.

edges.label: LCYB / CrtY · first β end
edges.detail: One beta end group is formed on the full C40 chain. Gamma-carotene need not accumulate as a free intermediate for every enzyme system.

edges.label: LCYB / CrtY · second β end
edges.detail: Cyclisation of the remaining open end forms the beta,beta framework.

edges.label: LCYE · ε-end reference
edges.detail: An epsilon cyclisation branch. The displayed delta-carotene record does not assign ring stereochemistry. LCYE ring-number specificity varies among enzymes.

edges.label: LCYB · β,ε branch reference
edges.detail: Matched epsilon and beta cyclisation supplies alpha-carotene. This summary does not fill in the unspecified stereocentre in the delta reference.

edges.label: β-Ring hydroxylation · two stages
edges.detail: Two hydroxylations are condensed; beta-cryptoxanthin appears in the full pathway view.

edges.label: Compatible ketolase · two stages
edges.detail: A suitable enzyme adds ketones to hydroxylated beta rings, via adonixanthin. Do not assume every BKT accepts the same substrates.

edges.label: Ring-specific hydroxylases
edges.detail: Beta and epsilon-ring hydroxylations require suitable enzyme combinations. This is not a universal one-step CrtZ conversion.

edges.label: Framework membership
edges.detail: An open-chain psi,psi C40 framework; classification only.

edges.label: Framework membership
edges.detail: One beta ring and one open end; classification only.

edges.label: Framework membership
edges.detail: One epsilon ring and one open end; classification only.
